[issue by SynixProject]
Not sure if its an internal corruption issue but on the latest update 1.21.10 the Decoration Table block seems to be a chunkban/crash object that immediately crashes anyone near the block itself.

[comment by P3pp3rF1y (owner)]
Somehow I missed testing decoration table and paintbrush during port and this slipped through. Just fixed the issue and released new version with the fix on curseforge/modrinth
